payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 44:1–16 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states at the north gate Ezekiel sees the LORD’s glory filling the temple, falls down, and receives new boundary instructions. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
